en: Doctor Fe del Mundo invented a bamboo incubator to keep premature babies warm in rural areas without electricity.

The Department of Health endorses lagundi leaves as a safe, natural scientific remedy to relieve coughs and asthma.
Rapidly expanding gases from a chemical reaction inside a PVC boga create pressure that can shatter the plastic pipe.
Citizens fulfill their civic duty to prevent dengue by applying the DOH 4S strategy to eliminate mosquito breeding sites.
National Scientist Ramon Barba discovered a simple flower-smoking technique that safely increases mango fruit production for Filipino farmers.
Scientists extract essential oils from the sampaguita, our national flower, to formulate calming aromatherapy and traditional medicinal remedies.
The Philippine Clean Air Act protects your right to breathe safely by banning the open burning of garbage.
The Pinggang Pinoy visual guide helps Filipino children practice the value of health by eating correct daily food portions.
